description: Preview a tip before preparing it: exact net amounts after the 98/2 split and estimated network fees, plus precondition checks — the recipient account exists and is associated with the tip token. Read-only; moves nothing. Call this before any flow that moves value — it catches tips that couldn't settle.

asset.description: HBAR (default) or an HTS token id like 0.0.456858

recipient.description: Blockpage username (e.g. user-10424063) or Hedera account id (0.0.x) receiving the tip
